protected_phrases: To open a route to a distant town,
That lets you sail much farther.

records.Japanese:
誰か他の勢力と事を構えるようならば
やはり大型船が必要になりますです
records.previous_English: Conflict with another power will require large ships.
records.english: Conflict with another power will require large ships.
records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.context: Hodram and Charles meet Cesare looking for the Elysion. Hodram recruits him for his knowledge and command experience. Cesare offers an optional lesson on choosing ships for trade, equipment, distance, and battle.
records.source_meaning: Conflict with another faction will make large ships necessary.
records.localization_note: The change from peaceful trade to conflict explains why large ships are needed.

records.Japanese:
せめて旗艦だけでも、海兵詰所と
武装砲台を備えた船を用意しないと
なかなか海戦には勝つことは
できませんです
records.previous_English: At least equip your flagship with marine quarters and armed batteries. Winning sea battles will be difficult otherwise.
records.english: Equip at least your flagship with marine quarters and armed batteries. It'll be hard to win at sea without them.
records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.context: Hodram and Charles meet Cesare looking for the Elysion. Hodram recruits him for his knowledge and command experience. Cesare offers an optional lesson on choosing ships for trade, equipment, distance, and battle.
records.source_meaning: At least the flagship should have marine quarters and armed batteries to make naval victories feasible.
records.localization_note: Preserve the minimum flagship recommendation and Cesare's warning that victories will be difficult.

records.Japanese:
…あとは所持金との相談です
大型を１隻買うよりも、中型を２隻買う
方が安いし、交易品もたくさん
積めます
records.previous_English: Mind your funds. Two medium ships cost less than one large ship and carry more goods.
records.english: Mind your funds. Two medium ships cost less than one large ship and carry more goods.
records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.context: Hodram and Charles meet Cesare looking for the Elysion. Hodram recruits him for his knowledge and command experience. Cesare offers an optional lesson on choosing ships for trade, equipment, distance, and battle.
records.source_meaning: Funds remain the constraint: two medium ships are cheaper than one large ship and can carry more merchandise.
records.localization_note: The comparison keeps the price and capacity advantages of two medium ships over one large ship.

records.Japanese:
いつかは大型船に買い換えることに
なりますが、将来、地方艦隊を作る
のであれば、お古の中型を売らずに
とっておいてもいいでしょう
records.previous_English: You'll eventually switch to large ships, but if you plan to form regional fleets, you may want to keep your old medium ships instead of selling them.
records.english: You'll move up to large ships. Planning to form regional fleets? You could keep your medium ships.
records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.context: Hodram and Charles meet Cesare looking for the Elysion. Hodram recruits him for his knowledge and command experience. Cesare offers an optional lesson on choosing ships for trade, equipment, distance, and battle.
records.source_meaning: Eventually large replacements will be needed, but old medium ships may be worth retaining for future regional fleets.
records.localization_note: Keep the later upgrade and the reason to keep the old ships. Express the alternative to selling as keeping them.
protected_phrases: You could keep your medium ships.

records.Japanese:
私の意見は以上であります。私は
これより出港準備にとりかかります
ではでは！
records.previous_English: That concludes my advice. I'll begin preparations to sail. Until later!
records.english: That's all my advice. I'll get ready to sail. Until later!
records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.context: Hodram and Charles meet Cesare looking for the Elysion. Hodram recruits him for his knowledge and command experience. Cesare offers an optional lesson on choosing ships for trade, equipment, distance, and battle.
records.source_meaning: Concludes the advice and excuses himself to prepare for departure.
records.localization_note: Close the optional lesson in Cesare's courteous voice and preserve his next action.
